data.why: The repository ships synthetic JSON/CSV fixtures explicitly meant for offline uploads through the Specification and Field gaps tabs; no real literature data or network access is required.

goals: Build a research specification (title, concept groups, population/methods) and validate it against the shared schema
Run a bounded literature discovery pass over uploaded local records and inspect proximity-ranked results with evidence excerpts
Search a field/topic for author-reported limitations and future-work gaps extracted from uploaded thesis records
Place a specific topic within a domain/field/subfield taxonomy and inspect neighboring topics
Export a single portable assistant-ready brief (and optional technical ZIP) summarizing findings and coverage

review.summary: The tree follows the tool's stated pipeline well: structured specification, bounded ranked retrieval with inspectable evidence, author-reported gap extraction, and a single assistant brief. Every screen I sampled supports its node, and the second agent replayed every task. It should be fixed before filing: add the Topic branches stage as a blocked phase, generalise one sandbox-specific label, and merge a few click-sized tasks.
